claims.assertion: Gosia says her first written contact with Swaruu de Erra began on December 17, 2017, after an intermediary introduced Robert and then her.
claims.speaker: Gosia
claims.qualifiers: She says Swaruu was aboard Toleka near Earth.

claims.assertion: Gosia says they began sharing contact conversations in 2018 through Robert’s and her YouTube channels.
claims.speaker: Gosia
claims.qualifiers: They decided the information should be shared with the world.

claims.assertion: Gosia says Yazhi arrived at Toleka from another timeline in early 2020, aged about seven or eight.
claims.speaker: Gosia
claims.qualifiers: She says Yazhi carried earlier Swaruus’ memories but remained distinct.
